title: From the Gettier Machine to Justified True Output: A Three-Step Account of Rational Trust in Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.38112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) settles into everyday practices of inquiry, an old epistemological question returns in a new guise: when does a proposition a user takes from an AI output become something the user knows, and when is it rational to trust it as such? This paper argues that the characteristic failures of AI-mediated inquiry are precisely those that the justified-true-belief (JTB) tradition and its post-Gettier anti-luck refinements were built to diagnose, and it advances three claims. First, AI outputs inherit neither the presumptive warrant of testimony nor the reliabilist warrant of deterministic tools: unaudited trust in a calculator rests on a type-level reliability record, and for general-purpose generative models there is no type-stable process to which such a record could attach -- a practical form of the generality problem. translated_title: 从盖梯尔机器到被证成的真输出：生成式人工智能中理性信任的三步解释
translated_abstract: 随着生成式人工智能（AI）融入日常的探究实践，一个古老的知识论问题以新的面貌重新出现：用户从AI输出中获取的命题何时才能成为用户所“知道”的东西，何时将其作为知识加以信任才是理性的？本文论证，AI中介探究的典型失败恰恰是“被证成的真信念”（JTB）传统及其盖梯尔问题之后的反运气修正理论所要诊断的那类失败，并提出三个主张。第一，AI输出既不继承证言的推定保证，也不继承决定论工具的可靠主义保证：对计算器的未经审计的信任建立在类型层面的可靠性记录之上，而对于通用生成模型而言，并不存在类型稳定的过程可供这种记录依附——这是“普遍性问题”的一种实践形式。第二，仅止步于获得输出的使用方式，会使生成式AI变成一台盖梯尔[机器]……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将知识论中的“被证成的真信念”（JTB）与盖梯尔反运气理论应用于诊断生成式AI的信任问题，指出AI输出既不具证言的推定保证、也不具可靠工具的类型稳定性保证，并提出一个三步框架，使用户能够将AI输出转化为可证成的“真输出”从而建立理性信任。
en_tdlr: This paper applies the justified-true-belief tradition and post-Gettier anti-luck refinements to diagnose trust in generative AI, arguing that AI outputs inherit neither testimonial nor reliabilist warrant, and proposes a three-step account for turning AI outputs into justified true outputs that warrant rational trust.
